gizmo.title: Chonga iindawo ezibalulekileyo
gizmo.description: Abafundi bafumana iindawo ezichanekileyo kumfanekiso ngokucofa, ukuthinta okanye ukuhambisa umnqamlezo wekhibhodi. Iqabane elimakwayo lemephu yomfanekiso.

configure.title: Isicatshulwa esingenye indlela
configure.description: Ichaza umfanekiso kubantu abangakwaziyo ukuwubona. Ayizange iboniswe njengesihloko.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko esifutshane esibonakalayo esiboniswa ngaphezulu komfanekiso.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Oko abafundi bacelwa ukuba bakufumane kumfanekiso.

configure.title: Iimpendulo
configure.description: Impendulo nganye yi-oval enegama kumfanekiso. Indawo nobungakanani ziipesenti zomfanekiso, zilinganiswa ukusuka kwikona yawo ephezulu ekhohlo. Ngelixa kuhlelwa, yonke impendulo ichazwa kumfanekiso.

advanced.title: Ukuphosa okuvumelekileyo
advanced.description: Kungakanani ukuphosa okuphelisa inzame. 0 kuthetha akunamda, kwaye abafundi bafumana iqhosha lokugqiba.

advanced.title: Iyasongeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lo mbuzo njengomqolo ovulekayo novalekayo. Ukuvula omnye kuvala eminye imibuzo esongekayo ecaleni kwawo.

advanced.title: Qala usongiwe
advanced.description: Xa isongeka, qala njengomqolo ovaliweyo obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

advanced.title: Ifomathi yokumaka
advanced.description: OER Schema: ifomathi yokumaka yolu vavanyo (umz. amanqaku, unobumba, ipesenti, ukugqitywa).

advanced.title: Injongo yokufunda
advanced.description: OER Schema: injongo yokufunda enxulumene nolu vavanyo.

developer.title: Igama lovavanyo
developer.description: Igama lovavanyo eligqithiselwayo ukuze lisetyenziswe kwiindawo eziqhutywa yi-xAPI ukuchonga le nto

developer.title: Ikhosi
developer.description: OER Schema: ikhosi olu vavanyo lwenzelwe yona.
